title: Kerusi Atas Meja
subject: a mamak shop worker at closing time hosing the floor and flipping chairs onto tables around the last two regulars who still won't get up
caption: Malay grunge, early-90s Seattle grunge rock, alternative rock with loud-quiet dynamics. Fuzz-heavy distorted rhythm guitar in the chorus, clean chorus-pedal arpeggio guitar in the verses, thick overdriven bass, loose live drums with crashing cymbals. Raw garage-room production, unpolished. Male lead vocal, low-mid register, raspy, clearly sung melody. 92 BPM, E minor. Weary, wry mood. No pop-punk, no autotune, no rap, no synths, no metal screaming.
lyrics:
[Intro - clean arpeggio guitar]

[Verse 1]
Air paip dah basahkan selipar aku
Kipas, lampu, aku tutup satu-satu
Korang berdua masih kacau teh tarik
Cerita yang sama dari pukul satu

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku tak halau, aku cuma tunggu

[Chorus - fuzz guitars]
Kerusi atas meja
Semua dah naik, tinggal korang berdua
Aku sapu keliling kaki korang
Esok pukul enam aku buka semula

[Verse 2]
Tauke dah balik dengan duit hari ni
Roti canai sisa aku bungkus sendiri
Korang tanya kenapa aku tak penat
Aku senyum, aku dah lupa rasa

[Chorus - fuzz guitars]
Kerusi atas meja
Semua dah naik, tinggal korang berdua
Aku tutup separuh shutter dulu
Korang tunduk keluar, jumpa esok pula

[Outro - clean guitar, feedback]
Kerusi atas meja
Aku pun duduk sekejap
